tasks.name: Self-Evolution - Loop Schedules and Skill Factory
tasks.description: Set up /loop 5-tier monitoring schedules and implement Skill Factory auto-generation logic. Create the skill auto-generation pipeline: pattern_candidates (occurrence>=3) -> skill-factory-agent generates SKILL.md -> deploy to .claude/skills/auto/.
tasks.notes: /loop max 50 concurrent, 72h expiry. For permanent schedules, use CronCreate. Anthropic skill-creator reference at command-center/anthropic-skills/skills/skill-creator/SKILL.md.
tasks.implementationGuide:
1. Set up /loop schedules in Claude Code session:
   /loop 5m check Observer health at localhost:3847/health
   /loop 30m check routing weights and suggest improvements
   /loop 2h check pattern candidates for skill generation
2. Create command-center/server/skill-factory.js module:
   - Query pattern_candidates where occurrence_count >= 3 and status = candidate
   - Generate SKILL.md template from tool chain pattern
   - Write to .claude/skills/auto/{skill-name}/SKILL.md
   - Update pattern_candidates status to deployed
   - Track in skill_performance table
3. Add /skills/generate endpoint to Observer API
4. Wire skill-factory-agent to use this endpoint
tasks.verificationCriteria: /loop schedules running (visible in Claude Code session). Skill Factory generates valid SKILL.md from pattern candidates. Auto-generated skill loads via hot-reload. Observer /skills/generate endpoint returns generated skill info.

tasks.name: Self-Evolution - Team Coordinator and Evolution Agent
tasks.description: Implement Team Coordinator (prevent worktree conflicts when multiple code-agents work simultaneously) and Evolution Agent periodic optimization (routing weight tuning, stale skill cleanup, MCP discovery).
tasks.notes: Team Coordinator is critical for Tier 3 (complex) tasks where multiple agents work in parallel. Evolution Agent runs in background via /loop or Cron.

relatedFiles.description: New module for agent team conflict prevention

tasks.implementationGuide:
1. Create command-center/server/team-coordinator.js:
   - Track active worktrees per agent
   - Before dispatching code-agent, check for file path conflicts
   - If conflict detected, queue or reassign to different worktree
   - Expose POST /team/dispatch and GET /team/status endpoints
2. Add evolution endpoints to Observer:
   - POST /evolve/optimize: trigger routing weight optimization
   - POST /evolve/cleanup: remove stale auto-skills (unused 30+ days)
   - GET /evolve/report: system health report
3. Wire evolution-agent.md to call these endpoints periodically
4. Set up CronCreate for permanent 6h and 24h schedules
tasks.verificationCriteria: Team Coordinator prevents two code-agents from modifying same file. Evolution Agent successfully optimizes routing weights. Stale skill cleanup works (skills unused 30+ days marked inactive). CronCreate schedules persist across sessions.
